```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(here)
library(mapview)
library(tidycensus)
```

## Read in the Data

```{r}
solar_oahu <- st_read(here("data/oahu_solar_dedup_simple.geojson"))

```

```{r}
mapview(solar_oahu)
```

## Retrieve some census data

```{r}
oahu_income <- get_acs(geography = "tract",
                          variables = "B19013_001",
                          state = "HI",
                          county = "Honolulu",
                          geometry = TRUE,
                          year = 2022)
```

```{r}
mapview(oahu_income, zcol = "estimate")
```

```{r}
mapview(oahu_income, zcol = "moe")
```

```{r}
ggplot(oahu_income, aes(x=estimate,y=moe))+
  geom_point()+
  geom_smooth(method = "lm")
```

```{r}
clean_solar_oahu <- solar_oahu|>
  filter(!st_is_empty(geometry)) |> 
  st_make_valid() |> 
  st_transform(crs = 26904)

oahu_tracts <- oahu_income |> 
  st_make_valid() |> 
  st_transform(crs = 26904)

```
